Winter Fest 2026 Debuts New Winter-Themed Tournament Experience

More than 70 teams competed across 16 brackets at Central Park as Playmaker Sports introduced Winter Fest-themed trophies, medals, pins, backdrops, and an expanded tournament app experience.

By Playmaker Sports

Winter Fest returned to Central Park in Santa Clarita with more than 70 teams competing across 16 brackets. The weekend brought clubs and families together for two full days of youth soccer and a new event experience built around the tournament's winter theme.

Champions and finalists received newly designed Winter Fest trophies and medals, while players could collect tournament pins and take photos at themed backdrops around the venue. Those details were created to give teams something memorable beyond the final whistle.

The Playmaker Sports Tournament App also played a larger role throughout the weekend. Families used it to follow schedules, scores, standings, and tournament updates from one place as competition moved through group play and championship matches.

Thank you to the players, coaches, referees, volunteers, partners, and families who helped make the 2026 event possible. Winter Fest will continue to grow as a competitive and welcoming stop on the Southern California youth soccer calendar.
